summary: The Phase 4 security re-review passes at 8a3e9cb9d with no blocker and one nonblocking Minor finding. Check 1 passes: both CD workflows and ci.yml hold workflow-level `permissions: contents: read`, no job widens it, no `pull_request_target` appears, and the CD workflows run on push only. Check 2 passes: the repository names two secrets, GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT and GCP_PROJECT_ID, and both sit in push-triggered jobs. Check 3 passes: the report names one traffic app, eight no-traffic apps, and one skipped app, and every gated row is in primary-advantage or reading-advantage, the two projects where the reduced key was measured. Check 4 passes: C30, plan task 2.6, and plan task 4.2 keep the reduced-key proof open until task 4.5; the report does not claim the key deploys. Check 5 passes with N1: the plan and the report do not contradict the follow-up track, but the plan does not name it. Check 6 passes: tasks 4.5, 4.6, and 4.7 are `[b]`, and task 2.3h is `[b] ... deferred:daniel`. A2 is not applicable and A6 has no hit.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Minor] review-b: the per_app_cicd plan does not name the follow-up track that gates the traffic runs. Plan task 2.3h (line 41) says only `every run needs Daniel's word. deferred:daniel`. test-strategy C31 (line 663) and Q18 say only that the first sales traffic move waits for `a small follow-up track`. The track now exists: `measure/tracks/sales_traffic_source_binding_20261108` (commits dbc669bff, 592d199e9, e2747094b). Its metadata says it blocks task 2.3h for six apps: sales-advantage (Phase 1) and accounts, accounting, codecamp-advantage, marketing, primary-advantage (Phase 2). Task 2.3h names five apps and not primary-advantage. So a reader of the plan can start the accounts, accounting, codecamp-advantage, or marketing traffic run with only Daniel's word, before `bind-release-source` exists. Those four files apply migrations from an uploaded tree that no step binds to `_RELEASE_COMMIT_SHA` (the F4 defect of C31). The impact is bounded: every run is `[b]` and needs Daniel's word, and the follow-up track holds the fix. The plan text does not contradict the track; it omits the pointer. A one-line pointer in task 2.3h and in C31 names the track, its six apps, and its Phase 2 order.

No file holds `pull_request_target`. cd-apps.yml line 5-6 and cd-www line 3-4 trigger on push to master only.

Check 2 passes: a grep for `secrets.` over `.github/workflows` finds four references and two names: GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (cd-apps.yml line 95; cd-www line 86) and GCP_PROJECT_ID (cd-www lines 91, 96, 106). ci.yml holds no secret reference. Both CD workflows are push-triggered, so a pull request from a fork runs no job that reads a secret.

Check 3 passes: dry-run-report.md line 28 names one traffic app (www-reading-advantage, through the direct workflow), eight no-traffic apps (accounting, accounts, codecamp-advantage, marketing, primary-advantage, sales-advantage, storytime, workbooks), and one skipped app (reading-advantage); the Dry runs table holds the 11 rows of the plan line. scripts/ci/apps.json puts primary-advantage and storytime in project primary-advantage and the other six gated rows in project reading-advantage, the two projects where plan task 2.6 measured the reduced key roles. Plan task 2.6 says the first push is the live proof and task 4.5 stays `[b]`. Plan task 4.2 says `Scope: local Node build and tests of the www closure only (C30); no Docker build, deploy key, Cloud Build, or live proof`. The report names no key and claims no deploy; its one traffic line is the future plan, and line 28 says Daniel decides the push.

Check 5 passes with N1: the follow-up track `measure/tracks/sales_traffic_source_binding_20261108` exists with commits dbc669bff, 592d199e9, and e2747094b. Its spec line 9 says it gates six apps and that task 2.3h keeps `deferred:daniel`. measure/tracks.md line 1640 records the same. The per_app_cicd plan and report do not contradict it: task 2.3h needs Daniel's word, and plan task 3.3a already moves sales traffic to the captured candidate revision, not to a tag. The plan does not name the track; that is N1.

Check 6 passes: plan lines 71 to 73 hold `[b] 4.5 ... deferred:pm`, `[b] 4.6 ... deferred:daniel`, and `[b] 4.7 ... deferred:pm`. Plan line 41 holds `[b] 2.3h ... deferred:daniel`. Task 4.4 stays `[~]`; tasks 4.1, 4.2, and 4.3 are `[x]`.
